purpose: Teach: デリー/サウジアラビア/ユナイテッド/ダライ/家康/ジュネーブ/トロイ/台北

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがデリー出張のお話して下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your father was telling us about his trip to Delhi.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact tone. Gentle pacing. Small smile in the voice—noticing her son's attentiveness. Natural conversational rhythm, bringing him into the moment.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとサウジアラビアの本見たよ
lines.en: Mom, I looked at a book about Saudi Arabia with Dad.
lines.style: Bright, earnest. Eager to share without being loud. Quick, precise delivery—he's proud of what he remembers. Slight lift at the end, looking for acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがマンチェスター・ユナイテッドの試合観に行かれたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father went to see a Manchester United match.
lines.style: Gentle, slightly distant recall. Warm undertone but observational—she's noticing something. Slow, deliberate pacing. A light trailing-off, as if remembering alongside him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとダライ・ラマのドキュメンタリー観たよ
lines.en: Mom, I watched a documentary about the Dalai Lama with Dad.
lines.style: Still eager but slightly quieter now—he's offering more, testing if she's really listening. Careful enunciation. The earnestness of a child wanting to be taken seriously.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが徳川家康の大河ドラマ観てらしたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father was watching a historical drama about Tokugawa Ieyasu.
lines.style: Calm, steady recall. Noticing a pattern now, but not saying it aloud. Warm but with a thread of quiet amusement. Measured pace, no rush. Soft close.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとジュネーブの絵本見たよ
lines.en: Mom, I looked at a picture book about Geneva with Dad.
lines.style: Still engaged, still bright. The rhythm slightly gentler now—he's settled into the exchange. Careful and genuine. A small, real smile in his voice.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがトロイの遺跡のドキュメンタリーをご覧になったわ
lines.en: Sho, your father watched a documentary about the ruins of Troy.
lines.style: Quieter now, almost reflective. She's following something. Warm acceptance in the tone. Slow, deliberate pacing. A sense of gentle understanding underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと台北旅行のお話したよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I talked about his trip to Taipei.
lines.style: Warm and settled. The smallest hint of satisfaction—he's been heard and understood. Soft attack, natural pacing, a quiet close. Genuine contentment in his voice.
